senses.gloss: m. pl.(b. h.; כָּסַס or נָכַס) [counted things,] account; property, business.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 46a:6">Ber. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>ויצלח מאד בכל נְכָסָיו ויהיו נכסיו ונְכָסֵינוּ וכ׳</he> may he have great success in all his accounts (enterprises), and may his business and ours be successful and near a city.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:7">B. Bath. IX, 7</cite>, a. fr. <he>נ׳ שיש להן אחריות</he>, v. <cite ref="A01052"><he>אַחֲרָיוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:7">Ib.</cite> <he>המחלק נכסיו וכ׳</he> if a person disposes of his belongings by word of mouth.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:3">Yeb. IV, 3</cite> <he>נ׳ הנכנסים וכ׳</he> property which the wife brings in and takes out again (v. <cite ref="M01495"><he>מְלוֹג</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:2">B. Kam. I, 2</cite> <he>נ׳ של בני ברית</he> Jewish property; <he>נ׳ המיוחדין</he> individual property; a. v. fr.
